cards.card_text: This one's a letter from James, who calls himself “a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ” and writes “To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion”.
cards.verse_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
cards.snippet: …and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
